misses.title: Optimized filter visits elements removed during its predicate
misses.reason: Capturing the original length without checking whether each index is still present causes callbacks on deleted entries. Native filter snapshots length but skips elements deleted before visitation. A predicate that shrinks an already-copied draft therefore receives undefined and can throw.
misses.base_result: With plugin enabled or disabled, callback only sees index 0, value.id 1, and returns [1].
misses.head_result: With plugin disabled, returns [1]; with plugin enabled, calls index 1 with undefined and throws Cannot read properties of undefined (reading id).
misses.notes: Bundles were built from git archives of exact base fee2c4fa1585d5131fc28a991853c692647632f7 and head d557de18207dd18bc28fb098f624e8bf6bb391bc. The external reproduction does not alter either review input.
